notes: A bundle of two or three different plates: the registry has no per-component scope, so facts that differ between the plates (thickness, surface, each plate's packaging size and weight, its own filament list and bed temperatures) stay as the deterministic per-plate x.* rows and description blocks. Curated here: facts true for every plate of a scope, and, per Combo Type, part.material and compat.statement written as one labelled string per plate (an option-scoped row replaces the product row of the same key for that selection, so the 3-plate row repeats the two plates every Combo Type contains).

Not curated: part.max_temperature for the 3-plate Combo Type (180 ℃ Textured PEI vs 120 ℃ for the other two); printing.supported_filament / unsupported_filament (they differ per plate; the compat.statement rows carry each plate's statement); a "requires glue" relation (only the Engineering Plate needs glue, and both Combo Types include a glue stick); compat.statement rows per Printer Model option that only repeat the option label (the compatible_with relations carry the printers, and such a row would replace the filament statements for every selection).

No in-the-box list is published; the Combo Type option names ("Cool Plate + Engineering (with Glue Stick)", "... + Texture PEl") are the only statement of contents.
